description: Delete a previously ingested file or data from the vector database. Use filePath for files ingested via ingest_file, or source for data ingested via ingest_data. Either filePath or source must be provided. Returns deleted (operation succeeded), removedChunks, and existed (whether anything was actually present).

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file (for ingest_file). Example: "/Users/user/documents/manual.pdf"

source.description: Source identifier used in ingest_data. Examples: "https://example.com/page", "clipboard://2024-12-30"

name: delete_file
